questions.stem: Which locker numbers remain open at the end of the process?
questions.solution: A locker remains open if it is toggled an odd number of times, which occurs when the locker number has an odd number of factors. Only square numbers have an odd number of factors because one of their factors is repeated (e.g., 4 = 2×2). The correct answer is 1, 4, 9, 16, 25. Other options include numbers with even numbers of factors, which would leave the lockers closed.
